verdict.label: Surface-proven (imported)
verdict.annotation: Strict KCode parsing, conformance to the V1 operation, direction, carrier, rack, selection, transfer, stop, and continuity contract, and the machine-safety envelope passed. 1 non-blocking float advisory remain visible as informational evidence. Controller acceptance, settings for this yarn, and physical knitting remain unproven.

diagnostics.title: Yarn floats farther than the advisory maximum
diagnostics.explanation: A carrier travels more needles between two consecutive stitches than the official editor's default float limit. Long floats can snag or pull; KCode does not record carrier in/out, so a gap spanning many passes may be a parked or cut yarn. Non-blocking advisory only.
diagnostics.message: Carrier 6 floats 33 needles from its last stitch in pass 100 to pass 254, 154 passes later (maximum 7). KCode does not encode carrier in/out, so a long gap may be a parked or cut yarn rather than a float.

disclosure: KCode bytes do not encode Knitout carrier in/out lifecycle or prove who produced them; checks begin at encoded KCode semantics.

Programmed travel is exact only in encoded stop-coordinate units. Millimetres and the constant-speed time term assume one coordinate unit equals one 3.63 mm needle pitch and encoded speed is constant mm/s; they are not physical duration or lower-bound claims.
Surface-proven remains software evidence; controller acceptance and physical knitting are separate gates.
Every check assumes the job starts with an empty needle bed and every yarn feeder parked at home on the left; the file cannot show either, so check both at the machine.
